verses.raw: Allāh will not impose blame upon you for what is meaningless<sup foot_note=254286>1</sup> in your oaths, but He will impose blame upon you for [breaking] what you intended of oaths. So its expiation<sup foot_note=254285>2</sup> is the feeding of ten needy people from the average of that which you feed your [own] families or clothing them or the freeing of a slave. But whoever cannot find [or afford it] - then a fast of three days [is required]. That is the expiation for oaths when you have sworn. But guard your oaths.<sup foot_note=254287>3</sup> Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses [i.e., revealed law] that you may be grateful.
